detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #10 Lone Wolf's Network Profile Tor routing comes with a different local network contract. Lonewolf uses its own seed-derived TCP/IP profile, with bounded ports, retry behavior, timers, and ICMP settings. It disables TCP timestamps and IPv6, including the settings on existing interfaces, then verifies the required values. Its dedicated firewall owns the routing policy. Normal-mode Network Drift and Ghost Stack are absent from this path, and local packet-persona transformation is not substituted for Tor. Each part of the session follows the requirements of the chosen mode. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
